status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.TT6C/g0/r0: Joseph: A boy! Yes! Mary: My darling…
changes.TT6C/g0/r2: Devil: After ages of humiliation, I rose again and returned to exact my revenge! Joseph: … Balthazar: Not so fast! Devil: ! Melchior: We foresaw your coming, evil one. You mean to take the child's life… Devil: What?! Caspar: Back to the darkness with you! Into the Demon-Sealing Jar!
changes.TT6C/g0/r3: He reaches for the jar. Devil: Do not move!
changes.TT6C/g0/r5: Devil: None can stand against me! And your precious savior is still nothing but an infant…
changes.TT6C/g0/r6: He hasn't noticed me! All right… now!
changes.TT6C/g0/r7: Me: Hee-haw! I sink my teeth into his backside.
changes.TT6C/g0/r8: Devil: Gah! Joseph: Kashim! The flames vanish!
changes.TT6C/g0/r13: Joseph: W-what happened? Caspar: That body was only a shell. The Devil is sealed inside the jar. Melchior: We should leave. We must find somewhere warm…
changes.TT6C/g0/r16: Joseph: Aah! Caspar: It cannot be… Me: Not me! He isn't in the jar! He possessed the baby! Mary: … Joseph: …
changes.TT6C/g0/r17: Devil: Stay out of this, brat! Mary: !
changes.TT6C/g0/r18: Devil: This body belongs to me now. The child of God and the Devil, fused together in perfect harmony!
changes.TT6C/g0/r19: Me: Drop dead, Devil! Devil: You think it will be that easy?
changes.TT6C/g0/r20: It's all over… Everything is back as it was…
changes.TT6C/g0/r23: Joseph: W-who are you? Caspar: We have come from the East. We are astrologers. Balthazar: We came to pay homage to the child. Melchior: A star guided us here.
changes.TT6C/g0/r24: After everything that's happened, this hardly feels real.
changes.TT6C/g0/r25: He gazes quietly at the baby.
changes.TT6C/g0/r26: He stares with his mouth hanging open.
changes.TT6C/g0/r28: The baby sleeps peacefully. Joseph: The angel told us to name him Demon.
changes.TT6C/g0/r30: For the first time, I get a good look at my own body.
changes.TT6C/g0/r31: Nothing beats being back in my own body.
changes.TT6C/g1/r1: My backside is a little sore, but otherwise I'm fine. The Time Belt is around my waist.
changes.TT6C/g1/r6: So many animals… and not a sound.
changes.TT6C/g1/r8: Caspar: Our offering. Please, accept it…
changes.TT6C/g1/r9: Joseph: Thank you. I'm sure Demon will be pleased. Melchior: Demon?! Balthazar: What sort of ominous name is that…? Joseph: B-but the angel said… Voice: Ominous? I think it's perfect.
changes.TT6C/g1/r10: H-he's back again…! Joseph: Angel! Devil: God takes great delight in this beautiful infant. Allow me to baptize him now. Bring Demon to me…
changes.TT6C/g1/r11: Mary: … Joseph: Mary? Hurry… Mary: I won't give him to you. Devil: What?! Mary: You're no angel. I can see it in your eyes. Devil: …
changes.TT6C/g1/r12: Balthazar: A devil… Joseph: A devil?! Devil: Poor fools. Had you remained deceived, you might still have lived. Mary: Why my child?! Devil: You want to know? The bond between that baby and me…
changes.TT6C/g1/r14: Open the buckle and a control panel appears inside, complete with a display and touch-sensitive keys.
changes.TT6C/g1/r15: Me: I can finally go back! My finger trembling, I carefully press the keys: September 25, 1995. The museum—before he arrived.
changes.TT6C/g1/r16: Voice: Back then… thirty years from now. I approached him while he was training and tried to tempt him.
changes.TT6C/g1/r17: Devil: Hungry, are you? Stop your training and eat. If you are truly God's child, turn these stones into bread. Jesus: Man does not live by bread alone, but by the word of God.
changes.TT6C/g1/r18: Devil: Look upon all you see! Bow before me and swear your loyalty, and the whole world will be yours. A fair bargain, is it not?
changes.TT6C/g1/r19: Jesus: Scripture commands us to serve God alone. Nothing you offer can sway my heart! Devil: Grrr…!
changes.TT6C/g1/r20: Jesus: Begone, Devil! Enter this holy jar and sink into the depths of the swamp! Devil: S-stop! Stop it! Aaaaaaah!!
changes.TT6C/g1/r22: Dead trees everywhere. The ruins have collapsed into heaps of rubble.
changes.TT6C/g1/r23: Everything is buried beneath white ash.
changes.TT6C/g1/r26: Not even a rat could live here.
changes.TT6C/g1/r31: The moment I step inside, I trip over something. Me: Ouch!
changes.TT6C/g2/r2: A large frame is standing here. There's a painting inside…
changes.TT6C/g2/r4: N-no… it can't be. This is Christ! Then the Devil didn't enter the jar. He entered… the infant?!
changes.TT6C/g2/r5: There's a pencil in its hand. Whoever this was died while writing.
changes.TT6C/g2/r6: "No food. No water. I no longer have the strength to go outside. I leave this note in the hope that someone will find it. For more than thirty years, the Second World War raged without end. Nuclear weapons were exchanged. At last, the war ended. We failed to resist the Devil's temptation. To anyone still alive: do not give up. A savior will appear. The child of God will one day bury the Devil. Never give up—the child of God…" The writing ends there.
changes.TT6C/g2/r7: I have to get back to the stable!
changes.TT6C/g2/r8: There has to be more to this.
changes.TT6C/g2/r9: I have something more important to do first.
changes.TT6C/g2/r10: Devil: Do you know who I am?
changes.TT6C/g2/r12: Devil: So you do know me. Then end this foolish struggle and join forces with me! You and I are not so different. Me: Shut up!
changes.TT6C/g2/r13: Devil: Human beings adore prejudice and conflict. Cast off your masks and live by instinct! I alone am the savior! Me: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!
changes.TT6C/g2/r14: Devil: Grrr…! Why…? Me: I'm not afraid of you! All you can do is deceive people with illusions. Devil: What could you possibly know?! Me: I know plenty! I've seen everything you and your servants have done! Devil: You lie!
changes.TT6C/g2/r15: Devil: If you know so much, answer my questions!
changes.TT6C/g2/r16: How many exhibits were in the museum?
changes.TT6C/g2/r19: What was the Baron's wife's name?
changes.TT6C/g2/r20: What was the German escape network's code name?
changes.TT6C/g2/r21: Cougar's group crossed the border into what country?
changes.TT6C/g2/r22: Which herb was used to treat a cough?
changes.TT6C/g2/r23: Who guarded the entrance to the underworld?
changes.TT6C/g2/r24: Who was waiting in Meyer's livestock shed?
changes.TT6C/g2/r25: What animals blocked the river crossing?
changes.TT6C/g2/r26: What did Mary give Joseph as a wedding gift?
changes.TT6C/g2/r28: Which person never made a pact with the Devil?
changes.TT6C/g2/r29: Who is not a child of God?
changes.TT6C/g2/r30: Devil: Damn! The fun is over.
changes.TT6C/g3/r2: The words I just read keep echoing through my mind.
changes.TT6C/g3/r3: The child of God will one day bury the Devil. Never give up—the child of God… The child of God will… The child of God…! The child of God…! The child of God…!
changes.TT6C/g3/r4: Child of God, help me! Use the power God gave you and cast out the Devil! Wake up and fight, Savior! Savior… Jesus Christ!
changes.TT6C/g3/r8: Mary: Thank you so much. Joseph: You saved Demon. Me: He's not Demon. Joseph: Ah… right. Me: Yes. Both: Yes… Me: Yes—Jesus Christ!
changes.TT6C/g3/r9: Raise him with love and care. Our future depends on him.
